title: Racial Demographics in Sarasota County
text:
This map explores the spatial distribution of the Black population across Sarasota County, Florida using 2020 Decennial Census data.
While the median census tract in Sarasota County has a Black population of only about 1.2%, North Sarasota (Census Tract 3, home to the historic Newtown community) is over 74% Black. This reveals striking geographic clustering within the county.
